spec_theorems.name: run_single_operand
spec_theorems.informal: With exactly one pathname operand, the utility returns the computed dirname line and successful exit status.

spec_theorems.name: output_has_one_line
spec_theorems.informal: For every single pathname operand, stdout consists of exactly one line.

spec_theorems.name: output_length_bound
spec_theorems.informal: For every single pathname operand, the number of output lines is at most one.

spec_theorems.name: output_is_documented_parent
spec_theorems.informal: The sole output line is the pathname produced by the documented dirname algorithm.

spec_theorems.name: successful_exit_code
spec_theorems.informal: A single valid pathname operand completes successfully with exit code zero.

spec_theorems.name: stdin_is_ignored
spec_theorems.informal: The result for a pathname operand is independent of the supplied stdin lines.
